# Deckent

> Deckent is a customer-installed Agent Control & Execution Plane for authorized, isolated work and durable business processes. Secure Core runs independently; proprietary Enterprise is separate.

These Markdown sources describe a pre-release. Read the AI installation guide first and preserve its person-only steps. The guide was re-checked against the alpha.58 candidate `f6b119d4f` (released 2026-10-29 as `0ba89deab`); npm publication and site deployment are separate release gates.

## Installation

- [AI installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/docs/ai-install.md): prerequisites, verified artifact installation, readiness, person-only steps and uninstall.
- [AI kurulum rehberi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/docs/ai-install.tr.md): the same guide in Turkish.
- [Product and source installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/README.md): current released scope and first session.

## Operation and limits

- [Architecture overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/docs/architecture-overview.md): typed contract, effects, isolation and signed Hub packages.
- [Known limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/docs/known-limits.md): refusals, recovery, platforms and unverified paths.

## Optional

- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): source workflow and targeted checks.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Verhex/deckent-next/main/SECURITY.md): supported scope and private vulnerability reporting.
